methodology.heroDesc: Interstate standard establishing a unified methodology for assessing technology readiness (TRL), manufacturing readiness (MRL), integration readiness (IRL) and system readiness (SRL) for technology transfer decisions and R&D management.
methodology.ugtSubtitle: Annex B, Table B.1 — full descriptions of technology readiness levels
methodology.whatIsUGTDesc: TRL (Technology Readiness Level) is a metric that quantitatively expresses the maturity of a technology under development. The scale includes 9 levels: from basic scientific principles (TRL 1) to successful operation in real conditions (TRL 9). Each level describes a specific state of the technology and criteria it must meet. TRL is the primary metric for transition decisions between development stages.
methodology.ugpSubtitle: Manufacturing readiness levels — from defining key factors to full-scale production
methodology.ugiSubtitle: Technology integration readiness levels into a system
methodology.ugsSubtitle: System readiness levels with numeric assessment ranges
methodology.processTitle: How assessment is conducted per GOST R 58048-2017
methodology.processSubtitle: Seven sequential steps — from self-assessment to technology development plan
methodology.step1Desc: Stakeholder (technology producer) conducts preliminary assessment against Annex B criteria of GOST R 58048-2017, filling a questionnaire for each critical technology element (CTE).
methodology.step2Desc: An independent team of domain experts is formed to conduct objective assessment. Experts must have competencies in the assessed technology field.
methodology.step3Desc: Critical technology elements are defined — key components and software on which assessment will be based. An evidence portfolio is formed for each CTE.
methodology.step4Desc: Factual data on achieved level is collected: test protocols, scientific publications, technical documentation, demonstration acts, R&D reports.
methodology.step5Desc: Independent team assesses CTE maturity: TRL (technology readiness), MRL (manufacturing), IRL (integration), SRL (system).
methodology.step6Desc: Based on answers, the percentage of criteria fulfillment for each level is calculated and a final report with detail across all assessment dimensions is formed.
methodology.step7Desc: Preparation of a report with recommendations for further technology development and an action plan to reach the target TRL. Timelines, resources and owners are defined.
methodology.matrixTitle: Correspondence of TRL, MRL, IRL and SRL scales
methodology.matrixSubtitle: Technology maturity is assessed across four interrelated scales

about.title: Center for Technological Development of the Udmurt Republic
about.lead: “Techno-maturity” is the digital platform of the CNTR UR. It turns technology maturity assessment from fragmented expert practices into a transparent standardized process: each technology gets a level per GOST R 58048-2017, and deployment readiness is decided on documents, not opinions.
about.missionText: The Center for Technological Development of the Udmurt Republic helps regional companies, research organizations and investors bring technologies to industrial application — from scientific idea to serial production.
about.legalText: Technology readiness is assessed per GOST R 58048-2017 “Technology development management. Assessment of technology readiness levels”. The platform relies on a package of methodological GOSTs and CNTR concept materials.
about.ecosystemText: Customers, R&D executors, scientific organizations, serial manufacturers, regulators, investors, auditors and the Center team work in a single contour: one project — one card, shared registries, transparent decisions.
about.whatGivesText: For customers — maturity assessment before procurement; for developers — a clear TRL growth path with documents for each stage; for investors — TRL 7+ technology registry; for the region — a unified picture of technological potential.

customers.title: Who the platform helps make technology decisions
customers.lead: The platform turns technology assessment from expert opinion into a verifiable process: official TRL, stage documents and CNTR manager decisions are visible to all project parties.
customers.card1Text: Assess development maturity before procurement or contract: official TRL per GOST R 58048-2017, stage documents and maturity radar instead of “trust me”. Manage portfolio of technology projects, team and budget in one workspace.
customers.card2Text: Show readiness of your developments for implementation: publications, patent research and research results are recorded as documents for TRL 1–3. Investors and manufacturers see the scientific backlog in platform registries.
customers.card3Text: Find technologies ready for implementation: TRL 7+ technology registry with filters by domain and budget. Apply for licensing directly from technology card.
customers.card4Text: Make decisions on data, not presentations: shared project registry with TRL levels, maturity radar and stage documents. The whole project path is visible — from draft to serial production.

performers.title: How the platform helps bring technologies to deployment
performers.lead: For performers the platform is a project workbench: documents, stages, verification and outreach to customers and investors via registries.
performers.card1Text: Lead technology projects through TRL levels: record stage results, upload documents and get auto-request for level-up automatically — by completeness. The platform will remind what's missing for N→N+1 transition.
performers.card1p1: Stage documents instead of shelf reports
performers.card2Text: Take mature technologies (TRL 7+) into licensing and production: technology registry with filters, card with documents and one-click license request.
performers.card3Text: Join projects via TZ-XXXXXX token and add verification documents — TRL confirmation. These go to CNTR manager queue and become material for official decision.
performers.card4Text: Show investors and customers an objective readiness level of your development. Express assessment is free and takes minutes — you'll immediately see which levels are missing to deployment.

ugtData.level1Short: Basic principles of the technology studied and published
ugtData.level2Short: Technology concept and/or its application formulated
ugtData.level4Short: Component and/or breadboard tested in laboratory environment
ugtData.level5Short: Component and/or breadboard tested in near-real environment
ugtData.level6Short: System/subsystem model demonstrated in relevant environment
ugtData.level7Short: System prototype demonstrated in operational environment
ugtData.level9Short: Real system proven through successful operation
ugtData.level1Desc: Fundamental principles identified and published. An idea for solving a physical or technical problem is formulated, with theoretical and/or experimental justification.
ugtData.level2Desc: Technological concept and/or potential applications formulated. Need and feasibility of new technology justified. Concept validity confirmed.
ugtData.level3Desc: Analytical and experimental confirmations of key functional capabilities provided. Calculated and/or experimental justification of technology effectiveness conducted.
ugtData.level4Desc: Workability and compatibility demonstrated on sufficiently detailed breadboards of devices under development in laboratory conditions.
ugtData.level5Desc: Main technological components integrated with supporting elements. Technology tested in simulated conditions close to operational.
ugtData.level6Desc: System/subsystem prototype contains all details of devices under development. Operability demonstrated in near-real conditions.
ugtData.level7Desc: System prototype successfully tested in field conditions. Operability demonstrated in real operational environment.
ugtData.level8Desc: System deemed fit for operation. Development, test & evaluation (DT&E) completed. System matches specification. Ready for serial production.
ugtData.level9Desc: System use concept successfully implemented. System installed and commissioned. OT&E completed. All production processes controlled by Six Sigma.
ugtData.level3Req1: Lab experiments on small-scale models conducted
